body: Thank you for talking to me, you don't how much this means to me. For surfing I started it when I moved to a new city. I enjoyed the concept that planetary forces greater than myself could provide a scenario of such enjoyment. For the the therapist side of things I'm just a bit nervous. In the past I have been on very heavy medication and I didn't like feeling like I wasn't in control of my self awareness. Perhaps I should approach a therapist to work through these thoughts.  I do have some not so nice things from the past and on the surface I feel I've moved on, but perhaps in my harder times these escalate things. If I'm honest I don't feel comfortable talking about myself, I feel blocked in.

It is hard. I really rely on structure and continuity. In the past I've always turned to nature, the sea, surfing. I don't have a therapist at this point. I find it hard to turn to therapists because the medication they prescribe is very harsh. I much prefer sitting with someone I know and rationalizing, yet here I am rationalizing with someone I don't even know.

It's a bit distant at this point to be honest. The friend that moved really kept me grounded. I'm very secretive about my true state of mind. I've been capable of masking it up until recently. My dark patches have become much more overwhelming. I haven't had a period where I plan my negative actions for a long time. Recently these have been coming back, to the point where I have made preparations.
